Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: original small mining probe's isolated rear-nozzle travel components, remaining physical headings, PHASE B.
Image1 is the S/SW/W/NW phase-A nozzle sheet: exact physical views/layout/hardware edit target.
Image2 is the SAME original component's N/NE/E/SE phase-B sheet: guide ONLY for the shorter actual blue/cyan jet pulse.
Keep image1's four opposite headings and preserve its exact charcoal-gray nozzle barrel, gray mounting collar, ONE narrow gold band, component scale, positions and upper-left SCREEN light.
Change ONLY each blue plume: shorten to about HALF of image1's present length, matching the compact phase-B pulse in image2. Crisp cyan core and narrow blue pixel edge, same axis/outlet. No added jet, halo, haze, smoke, sparks, flare or moving nozzle hardware.

Physical component orientations stay:
TOP LEFT S: mounting end DOWN, nozzle outlet/jet exactly UP;
TOP RIGHT SW: mounting end LOWER LEFT, outlet/jet UPPER RIGHT;
BOTTOM LEFT W: mounting end LEFT, outlet/jet exactly RIGHT on a HORIZONTAL axis;
BOTTOM RIGHT NW: mounting end UPPER LEFT, outlet/jet LOWER RIGHT.
True opposite physical camera views, fixed elevated orthographic Tycoon camera, never flat mirror/rotation. Preserve crisp restrained classic pixel-art model and materials.

Preserve the input's ACTUAL CLEAN TRANSPARENT ALPHA interiors and magenta source separator layout; empty pixels must remain alpha0.
NO checkerboard, white/gray/pink fill, fog, gradient background, glow haze or painted transparency preview. Hidden RGB outside alpha may be flat magenta; do not paint visible colored backgrounds.
Keep1536x1024 and four fully separated small component cutouts with ample transparent clearance to their exterior source frames/gutters.
No text, letters, numbers, arrows, labels, stars, floor, cast shadow, spacecraft hull or extra props.
Four SAME genuine S/SW/W/NW original nozzles with only their blue jet shortened into actual PHASE B.
